purpose: Measure whether the actual national 100 m HICAR domain fits, converges, writes and rereads an exact-end restart, and sustains a short continuation with the same qualified source selected for the 200 m month. Passing qualifies engineering capacity only.

case.source_identity: derive from and checksum-freeze a published passing month-source qualification when the capacity plan is created
case.land_initialization: static-domain engineering defaults; not scientifically qualified REA-L land/snow state

interpretation: The test exercises the actual national DEM, decomposition and 80-level SLEVE grid; no small domain is treated as a proxy.
The two-hour initial segment must publish a full exact-end restart. The continuation must explicitly read that restart and publish only the two new hourly records.
Per-GPU device memory and per-node available host memory are sampled once per second for every segment.

Timing evidence includes Slurm wall time, model initialization and physics timers, forcing and output timers, restart-write wall upper bound, validation wall time, bytes written, and solver iterations.
Passing does not validate 100 m physics, added value, land-state spin-up, or long-duration drift.
A capacity result from a source other than the selected 200 m month source is ineligible for scientific scaling.
